newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent down slightly but supported.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent down slightly but supported.

text.p: SIMEX Brent November crude futures were slightly lower in late trading on Friday, but supported, brokers said.
November Brent was last traded at $22.86 per barrel, down seven cents from London's close on Thursday. The last trade was also the intraday high having traded as low as $22.80.
Market volume was concentrated in November at 74 lots.

Brokers said the decline was a continued consolidation of this week's rally but added there was underlying support for the market because of worries over the low distillate inventories both sides of the Atlantic.
November crude on NYMEX fell 30 cents to $24.16 on Thursday and slipped further on the after-hours ACCESS to last trade at $24.00, up from the intraday low of $23.95.

October heating oil, which fell in New York 0.87 cent to 70.90 cents per gallon after hitting a post Gulf War high of 72.50 cents, was last traded at 70.55 cents on just 14 lots, unchanged from earlier in the day.
